jobs.title: Sr DevOps Engineer (AWS OR Azure)
jobs.description:
Experience- 3 Years - 6 Years


Organization- Emplay Analytics Inc


Salary (CTC) - As per company standards


Job Location- Remote/Work from Home (India)


About the Role
We are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer with strong hands‑on experience in Linux, Docker, Cloud, (AWS/Azure), scripting, application deployments, and production troubleshooting.


Key Responsibilities

Manage application deployments, maintenance, upgrades, and day‑to‑day operations across cloud and containerized environments.
Administer and maintain Linux/Unix servers and related infrastructure.
Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes.
Work with AWS and/or Azure cloud infrastructure and services.
Troubleshoot production issues by analyzing application and Docker logs, system resources, configurations, networking, and service dependencies.
Perform root‑cause analysis (RCA) and implement, validate, and document appropriate solutions.
Develop and maintain Bash/Shell scripts for infrastructure automation, deployment, health checks, troubleshooting, and operational tasks.
Support microservices‑based applications and troubleshoot service connectivity, configurations, environment variables, ports, volumes, and dependencies.
Work with SQL databases and Redis for operational troubleshooting, data validation, and infrastructure support.
Configure and manage Nginx/Apache and troubleshoot reverse proxy and service connectivity issues.
Automate repetitive operational activities to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Required Skills & Experience

3–6 years of relevant experience in DevOps, Cloud Operations, Linux Administration, or Infrastructure Engineering.
Strong hands‑on experience with Linux server administration.
Strong hands‑on experience with Docker and Docker Compose.
Strong working experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
Good knowledge of AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
Strong proficiency in Bash/Shell scripting and infrastructure automation.
Strong experience with Docker/container log analysis.
Good understanding of SQL and relational databases.
Working knowledge of Redis or similar infrastructure components.
Good understanding of networking, DNS, ports, HTTP/HTTPS, reverse proxies, and service connectivity.
Experience configuring and managing Nginx and/or Apache.
Good understanding of Linux CPU, memory, disk, processes, permissions, filesystems, and system resource troubleshooting.
Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools.
Ability to independently diagnose issues across application, infrastructure, database, and service dependencies.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem‑solving skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure as Code tools.
Exposure to Helm and Kubernetes deployment management.
Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, CloudWatch, or similar monitoring and logging solutions.
Experience with Python for infrastructure automation and tooling.
Understanding of Docker, Linux, and cloud security best practices.
Experience managing multi‑tenant or customer‑specific cloud/containerized environments.
Familiarity with incident management, RCA, and preventive actions.

You will evolve from infrastructure-level automation toward high-level microservice development, ensuring our platform remains scalable, secure, and highly performant as we drive Cisco’s transition to cloud-recurring business models.

Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.



Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 



We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.description:
Role & responsibilities


Client is seeking a motivated and enthusiastic Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing technology team. You will play a crucial role in building, deploying, and maintaining our infrastructure and applications on Amazon Web Services (AWS). This is an excellent opportunity to learn and grow your DevOps skills in a supportive and collaborative environment.


Responsibilities

Assist in the design, implementation, and management of AWS infrastructure using EKS, ECS, API Gateway and other related technologies.
Contribute to the automation of deployment processes using Terraform, CloudFormation, and scripting languages.
Participate in the design, implementation, monitoring and alerting of systems and applications to ensure high availability and performance.
Collaborate with development teams to integrate and deploy applications on AWS.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and application deployment issues.
Contribute to the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines.
Implement best practices for security, scalability, and cost optimization in AWS.
Document processes and configurations.
Stay up to date with the latest AWS services and DevOps trends.

Qualifications

Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Experience with the following technologies:
Containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, EKS, Kubernetes).
Infrastructure as code (IaC), specifically Terraform.
Monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).
Configuration management tools (e.g., Packer, Ansible).
Relational database technology (e.g., SQL/PSQL).
Experience with at least one scripting language (e.g., Python, Bash).
CI/CD pipelines and related technologies.
Linux operating systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
A proactive attitude and a willingness to learn.
